lines: +Per generated token, with the trainer distribution `p` (temperature-scaled
+exactly as the policy loss scores it, and renormalized over the realized
+sampling support when sampling-support replay is on) and the sampler
+distribution `q` recorded at generation time, the loss is (eq. 12)
+    L = -A * ( sg[w_y] * log p_y - sum_{v in H} sg[q_v w_v - alpha p_v] * log p_v )
+where `H` is the recorded top-k candidate head, `rho` reconstructs the tail
+(eq. 7), and `w`/`alpha` compose the chosen importance-sampling weight
+function (eq. 9-10). The sampled token's weight always uses its recorded
+log-prob, also when it is not among the stored candidates.
+The chunk kernel is a vocab-parallel autograd function in the shape of
+Megatron's fused cross-entropy: forward turns each fp32 logits chunk into its
+softmax in place and saves only that (plus the small per-token coefficients)
+for backward, where the logits gradient is
+    dL/dz_u = e_u - p_u * sum_v e_v,   e = the sparse head/sample coefficients,
+so peak memory tracks the policy loss it replaces instead of materializing a
+def _is_weight(ratio: torch.Tensor, *, is_mode: str, tis_clip: float, mis_low: float, mis_high: float) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """f(r) of App. A.2 for the configured composition."""
+        return torch.where((ratio >= mis_low) & (ratio <= mis_high), ratio, torch.zeros_like(ratio))
+    if group is not None and dist.is_initialized() and group.size() > 1:
+    """Per-token score-centering surrogate over one vocab-parallel chunk.
+    Inputs are the fp32 (already temperature-scaled, already sampling-masked)
+    logits chunk `[R, V_local]` this TP rank owns, the sampled tokens, the
+    recorded head ids/log-probs (`-1` pads a missing candidate), and the
+    sampled token's recorded log-prob. Outputs `(base, logp_y)` where
+    `base = -(w_y logp_y - sum_H coeff_v logp_v)` (the loss before the
+    advantage factor) and `logp_y` is the sampled token's trainer log-prob;
+    both are differentiable w.r.t. the logits through the hand-written
+    backward. The input chunk is a fresh upcast copy owned by the caller; it
+    is mutated into the saved softmax, exactly like the fused CE kernel.
+    def forward(ctx, logits, tokens, head_ids, head_logq, selected_logq, tp_group, tp_rank, is_mode, tis_clip, mis_low, mis_high):
+        # A candidate the trainer distribution cannot reach (masked out of the
+        # sampling support) has no recorded-q meaning here; drop it rather
+        alpha = rho * _is_weight(1.0 / rho, is_mode=is_mode, tis_clip=tis_clip, mis_low=mis_low, mis_high=mis_high)
+            head_valid, _is_weight(ratio_head, is_mode=is_mode, tis_clip=tis_clip, mis_low=mis_low, mis_high=mis_high), torch.zeros_like(ratio_head)
+        ctx.save_for_backward(softmax, head_ids, coeff, tokens, coeff.sum(dim=-1) - w_y, -w_y)
+        softmax, head_ids, coeff, tokens, sum_e, e_y = ctx.saved_tensors
+        # Reuse the saved softmax as the gradient buffer (single backward, as
+        # in the fused CE / vocab-parallel entropy kernels).
+        y_values = torch.where(y_local, grad_base * e_y + grad_logp_y, torch.zeros_like(sum_e))
